org.name: Doncaster and Bassetlaw Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust

theme: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

reports.title: Kathleen McGeary
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: We have developed a new CDU(Clinical Decision Unit) standard operating procedure, which | attach, where it makes clear where responsibility lies for various aspects of the patient pathway. It also has CDU pathway document that aids the communication between the main hospital department and CDU on admission. This has now been implemented.
promises.summary: Implement new CDU standard operating procedure to clarify responsibilities

concerns.quote: There was little evidence that Mrs McGeary (who suffered from dementia and was vulnerable) was fully and properly assessed, investigated, diagnosed and treated before discharge
concerns.hazard: inadequate assessment of vulnerable patient with dementia

concerns.quote: No clinician took clear responsibility for discharge decision making. The recording of the identity of the discharging clinician was incorrect and communication between clinicians and nursing staff was unclear
The electronic discharge summary was inadequate and no paper discharge summary was produced. No explanation was given for this omission
Mrs McGeary left hospital by hospital arranged transport without the antibiotics she had been prescribed for a suspected UTI. No explanation was given for this failing
At Inquest there appeared a culture of acceptance of the above failings and omissions without any corresponding will or effective plan to address them
concerns.hazard: culture of acceptance of systemic failures

reports.title: Jacob Owczarek: Prevention of future deaths report
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: A sepsis audit tool Task and Finish group with MDT input from both Paediatric and ED teams has been set up to review the audit tool for sepsis management, which will audit the pathway from the point of arrival in the Emergency Department. Due to the complexity of the different referral pathways this is a complex audit tool to develop, it is currently in the final stages of development, the aim is to pilot this in Q3. For Q2 the current audit tool will be used.
promises.summary: Set up audit tool task and finish group to review sepsis management pathway

concerns.quote: Continuing low compliance with the Paediatric sepsis screening tool
concerns.hazard: low compliance with paediatric sepsis screening tool

concerns.quote: Lack of Named/Responsible Consultant review prior to a child's discharge
concerns.hazard: lack of named responsible consultant review prior to discharge

concerns.quote: No alert/review system for ICE results yet in place for all the Paediatric team
concerns.hazard: absence of alert system for ICE results

concerns.quote: No current system for recording a discussion about a child, in the Radiology meetings (where important investigations are planned)
concerns.hazard: lack of documentation of radiology discussion about child

concerns.quote: The risk of continuing Login issues when Locum doctors are working at the Trust
